cases.name: overload
cases.source:
Dec twice(x) -> y:
    (int x) -> int y:
        y = x + x
    (ratio x) -> ratio y:
        y = x + x
Dec main() -> result:
    () -> int result:
        assert twice(ratio(1, 3)) == ratio(2, 3)
        result = twice(9)

cases.name: closure_replay
cases.source:
Dec cycle(t) -> out:
    (trace t) -> trace out:
        t = step(t, q4(1), t1(1))
        t = hinge(t)
        out = close(step(t, q4(0), t1(-1)))
Dec main() -> result:
    () -> int result:
        trace a = cycle(trace("s", "a", q4(0)))
        trace b = cycle(trace("s", "b", q4(0)))
        assert phases(close(a)) == 1
        assert beats(a) == 0
        assert phases(cycle(a)) == 2
        result = phases(a)

cases.name: example_closure
cases.source:
# Each return retains the start and a structural hinge.
Dec recur(t) -> out:
    (trace t) -> trace out:
        t = step(t, q4(1), t1(1))
        t = hinge(t)
        t = step(t, q4(0), t1(-1))
        out = close(t)

Dec main() -> result:
    () -> t32 result:
        trace a = trace("B", "a", q4(0))
        a = recur(a)
        assert phases(a) == 1
        assert beats(a) == 0
        a = close(a)
        assert phases(a) == 1
        a = recur(a)
        assert phases(a) == 2
        assert beats(a) == 1
        emit a
        emit rate(a)
        result = t32(0)

cases.name: example_coupling
cases.source:
# Equal acquisition spans, two distinct return contacts, and an unwrapped lag.
Dec recur(t) -> out:
    (trace t) -> trace out:
        t = step(t, q4(1), t1(1))
        t = hinge(t)
        t = step(t, q4(0), t1(-1))
        out = close(t)

Dec main() -> result:
    () -> t32 result:
        trace a = trace("B", "a", q4(0))
        trace b = trace("B", "b", q4(0))
        a = recur(a)
        a = recur(a)
        a = dwell(a)
        b = dwell(b)
        b = recur(b)
        b = recur(b)
        coupling pair = coupling(a, b, "seven-events")
        pair = contact(pair, 3, 4)
        pair = contact(pair, 6, 7)
        emit cadence(pair)
        emit lag(pair)
        emit drift(pair)
        result = t32(0)

cases.name: example_fusion
cases.source:
# The inner closures propose a fold. The outer trace must itself return.
Dec recur(t) -> out:
    (trace t) -> trace out:
        t = step(t, q4(1), t1(1))
        t = hinge(t)
        t = step(t, q4(0), t1(-1))
        out = close(t)

Dec main() -> result:
    () -> t32 result:
        trace a = recur(trace("inner", "a", q4(0)))
        trace b = recur(trace("inner", "b", q4(0)))
        fusion proposal = fold(a, b, "outer", "ab")
        trace c = outer(proposal, q4(0))
        c = recur(c)
        c = fuse(proposal, c)
        assert phases(c) == 1
        emit c
        result = t32(0)

cases.name: example_ternary
cases.source:
# Balanced ternary arithmetic with explicit constructors and exact ratios.
Dec add(a, b) -> c:
    (t32 a, t32 b) -> t32 c:
        c = a + b
    (ratio a, ratio b) -> ratio c:
        c = a + b

Dec main() -> result:
    () -> t32 result:
        t32 x = add(t32(1), t32(1))
        assert x == t32(2)
        assert unpack(pack(x)) == x
        emit x
        ratio r = add(ratio(1, 4000000000), ratio(1, 4000000000))
        assert r == ratio(1, 2000000000)
        emit r
        result = t32(0)

cases.name: example_weights
cases.source:
# A declared exact ternary continuation kernel, no implicit sampling law.
Dec main() -> result:
    () -> t32 result:
        ratio returned = probability(2, 1, 3, t1(-1))
        ratio hinge_weight = probability(2, 1, 3, t1(0))
        ratio outgoing = probability(2, 1, 3, t1(1))
        assert returned + hinge_weight + outgoing == ratio(1, 1)
        emit returned
        emit hinge_weight
        emit outgoing
        result = t32(0)
